patterns.what_worked: Collector/renderer split made the report assertable as a table; 24 structural pins run inside the existing per-client load matrix; every gate was run on all three interpreters.
patterns.what_was_hard: The load_test uses a checks array rather than check(), and the report had to keep every pre-existing pinned substring while changing its internal shape; the temporary sample dump was used to inspect the real output, then removed.
patterns.skill_gap: No in-game client here, so the operator still has to confirm the pasted report on Era/TBC; the existing portrait-side contract remains an open operator decision.
